messages:
ana (Docs): Heads-up: APAC2 deploy changed endpoint pattern. Need to update localization + geo availability docs and SDK snippet. Anyone who touched endpoints?

matt (Eng): That was me. New endpoints follow a region-aware pattern: api-{region}.inference.redwood.com. APAC2 region id is apac-2. For Private deployments we also surface a `data_residency` flag to control where artifacts are stored. No breaking changes to request payloads.

ana (Docs): Can you paste the minimal SDK init snippet? Want both python and js examples (short).

matt (Eng): ```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(region='apac-2')
# or explicit endpoint
client = RedwoodClient(endpoint='https://api-apac-2.inference.redwood.com')
```

```js
import Redwood from '@redwoodai/sdk';
const client = new Redwood({ region: 'apac-2' });
```

matt (Eng): Also note: streaming host changes to api-apac-2 but streaming protocol & auth unchanged. Add a short note in the streaming section so customers know which host to target.

jia (Intl): We should add a localized footnote for the data residency option (JP/KR/FR). I'll add translations to docs/l10n/geo-footnotes.yaml — will link them from the main page.

sarah (PM): Quick Q: do customers need different billing/pricing notes per region? If yes, we should surface that near the availability table.

matt (Eng): Hosted pricing is consistent, but Dedicated commitments can vary by region. Suggest linking to /pricing/regions and to the Dedicated regions table.

ana (Docs): Plan: update "Geo availability" page with new APAC2 row, add SDK snippets (python/js), add concise footnote about data residency and link to compliance page. @jia please review localized copy in the PR, @sarah please confirm customer-facing wording.

docs-bot: Docs CI: build passed for PR #4567 (:white_check_mark:) — https://ci.redwood.ai/pr/4567

jia (Intl): I'll review translations in that PR today and add JP/KR strings. Also will check pluralization for the footnote.

sarah (PM): Small copy tweak: prefer the phrase "data residency options" over "data sovereignty" for the public docs. Also add a short support path: "Contact support to request residency guarantees."

ana (Docs): Good call, will replace wording and add support link: https://support.redwood.ai/residency-requests. Also will add a short example snippet for Dedicated commit flow.

docs-bot: PR #4567 merged by ana (Docs) (:tada:) — https://ci.redwood.ai/pr/4567/merge

ana (Docs): Thanks all — updated staging site at https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/geo-availability. Scheduling prod deploy 09:00 UTC tomorrow. If anyone sees an issue please flag here. :rocket:
